import calendar
now = datetime.now()

def is_expired(card):
    exp_year = int(card['expiry_year'])
    exp_month = int(card['expiry_month'])
    last_day = calendar.monthrange(exp_year, exp_month)[1]
    exp_date = datetime(exp_year, exp_month, last_day, 23, 59, 59)
    return now > exp_date
